title: Who parked a truck of stones?
situation: The founder alleges stone-pelting was by ruling-party "goons", not students, and asks who parked a stone-laden truck at Jantar Mantar; he says police told him it was a municipal truck. Police separately say 2,873 people with criminal records were at the sites (facial recognition).

lines.text: He asked who brought a truck loaded with stones; police told him it was an MCD truck.
lines.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke

lines.text: We ourselves saw who brought the stones
lines.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke

buildThis.situation: A municipal dumper full of rubble is parked by the RUP SUV from 14:00; if nobody films or moves it, the provocateurs' first stones come from it.

doNotInfer: who actually threw stones; both sides' claims are unverified
